description: Distribution Substation Daily Capacity & Utilisation (Latest Available) is a dataset listed in Endeavour Energy Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Endeavour Energy - Data Products. Daily Distribution Substation (DSUB) capacity and utilisation metrics derived from GridSight DAY/ESTIMATION thermal performance data. Each DSUB record represents the most recent available estimate for that substation, with the source date retained for transparency. Includes capacity, peak load, headroom, utilisation and data freshness (daysold), with automatic aggregation across multiple transformers where applicable. Coverage: Endeavour Energy network area, New South Wales. The portal files it under Energy Transition. Its keywords are Capacity, Dsub, Distiribution Substation, Estimates. The portal shows 29,265 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-endeavourenergy-com-au-portal.
